label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.3 a.8… supports Every component of anything is in POTENCY_1…
note: The third reason of q.3 a.8 excludes matter because it is in potency and a form that is part of a composite because it is participated. It names these two kinds of component; it does not state that every component is one of them. The encoded statement reads the two kinds as exhaustive, and reads 'participated form' as having its being by participation (DEF-PARTICIPATED-ESSE).
